why: Fill your opponent's hand with Ruby Fish creates new cards in a hand.
Create and play a unit from your opponent's starting deck creates a new card in hand.
Shuffle a Rock into your opponent's deck puts a new card into a deck.
plant a Mysterious Portal and 3 Chimes puts new cards into decks.
create a random single-use Malicious Card and put it in the enemy's deck creates new cards.
Spawn a Drone at the bottom of your opponent's deck creates a new card in a deck.
Rush lets the copied minion move and attack right away.
It gains Rush so the unit can move and attack immediately.
All other Vek heal 1 at the start of their turn restores lost health.
All other Vek are Boosted, providing +1 damage to attacks adds damage, not healing.
Regeneration heals every other Vek 1 each turn, restoring lost health.
Give Veil to a unit: Veil "prevents unit from gaining other statuses", so it is status immunity.
Upgraded Shield "Creates a personal Shield" that blocks damage and stops new negative statuses.
Green mutagen "give it Veil" so the allied unit blocks other statuses.
Upgrade "Applies a Shield to buildings" that blocks damage and negative statuses.
Veil on itself stops it gaining other statuses.

Drain an enemy unit by 3, then "boost self by the damage dealt"; Regis grows.
Drain an enemy unit by the amount of boost it has, then boosts self by the damage dealt.
